interval_years.quote: An optometrist licensed by the board shall pay annually, before the first day of April, to the board a license renewal fee

required.quote: As a condition of renewal of a license to practice, a license applicant must complete continuing education during the licensing cycle prior to application for renewal

period_years.quote: during the licensing cycle prior to application for renewal

available.quote: The board shall establish a process to issue a license by endorsement to a license applicant who presents proof of licensure by another jurisdiction

requirements.value: Applicant must be in good standing in all jurisdictions where licensed, have no pending complaints or investigations, no suspended or restricted licenses, never surrendered or had a license revoked, pass a jurisprudence examination, and meet substantially equivalent license requirements
requirements.quote: the license applicant is in good standing in all jurisdictions in which the license applicant holds or has held a license... the license applicant passes a jurisprudence examination

definition_quote.value: The examination, diagnosis, treatment and management of diseases, injuries and disorders of the eye and associated structures, as well as identification of related systemic conditions affecting the eye without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers; and the provision, replacement or duplication of an ophthalmic lens without a written prescription from an individual licensed under the laws of this State to practice either optometry or medicine
definition_quote.quote: The examination, diagnosis, treatment and management of diseases, injuries and disorders of the eye and associated structures, as well as identification of related systemic conditions affecting the eye without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers; and   [PL 2023, c. 580, §8 (NEW).]B. The provision, replacement or duplication of an ophthalmic lens without a written prescription from an individual licensed under the laws of this State to practice either optometry or medicine.

value: treatment and management of ocular diseases
methods_authorized.quote: The examination, diagnosis, treatment and management of diseases, injuries and disorders of the eye and associated structures... The provision, replacement or duplication of an ophthalmic lens without a written prescription from an individual licensed under the laws of this State to practice either optometry or medicine.

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may use and prescribe diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for ocular conditions, subject to restrictions on controlled substances and injection-based drugs
drug_authority.quote: Pharmaceutical agent means any diagnostic and therapeutic substance for use in the diagnosis, cure, treatment, management or prevention of ocular conditions and diseases, but does not include drugs administered exclusively by injection, except injections for the emergency treatment of anaphylactic shock

surgery_prohibited.quote: without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers

surgery_definition.value: Invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers are prohibited
surgery_definition.quote: without the use of invasive surgery or tissue-altering lasers

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: An optometrist who graduated from optometric college in the year 1996 or thereafter and who is an advanced therapeutic licensee is authorized to independently treat glaucoma

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: except injections for the emergency treatment of anaphylactic shock

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: the prescribing, adapting and application of ophthalmic lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision therapy, pharmaceutical agents and prosthetic devices

value: Schedules III, IV, V permitted with restrictions
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Controlled substances identified in schedules I and II as described in 21 United States Code, Section 812... any drug identified in schedules III, IV and V as described in 21 United States Code, Section 812, for any purpose associated with ocular conditions and diseases except for oral chemotherapeutic agents, oral immunosuppressive agents and oral immunostimulant agents
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.citation: [32 §19304. Levels of licensure and license requirements for use of pharmaceutical agents]

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: an optometrist who has received a therapeutic advanced license may prescribe one 5-day supply of any analgesic identified in schedules III, IV and V
opioid_prescription_day_limit.citation: [32 §19304. Levels of licensure and license requirements for use of pharmaceutical agents]

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: except for oral chemotherapeutic agents, oral immunosuppressive agents and oral immunostimulant agents
oral_pharmaceutical_authority.citation: [32 §19304. Levels of licensure and license requirements for use of pharmaceutical agents]

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Only an optometrist licensed under this section may use or dispense pharmaceutical agents or drug samples
pharmaceutical_certification_required.citation: [32 §19304. Levels of licensure and license requirements for use of pharmaceutical agents]

tiered_license_types.quote: The following are the levels of licensure. A. The board may only issue a therapeutic advanced glaucoma license for a new licensee... B. The therapeutic advanced license... C. The therapeutic license... D. The diagnostic license level
tiered_license_types.citation: [32 §19304. Levels of licensure and license requirements for use of pharmaceutical agents]

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: The board may not approve a course that does not include a minimum of 100 hours of ocular therapeutics including at least 25 hours of supervised clinical training

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: at least 25 hours of supervised clinical training in the examination, diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the eye and its adnexa

telemedicine_authorized.quote: A person licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services as long as the licensee acts within the scope of practice of the licensee's license

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: The contact lens prescription must contain an expiration date not to exceed 24 months from the date of issue

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: After the conclusion of an eye examination, the optometrist shall provide a copy of the spectacle prescription to the patient, at no cost

patient_record_retention_years.quote: An optometrist shall maintain complete records of all eye care provided, as well as any prescriptions or programs of corrective procedure. This information for each patient must be kept and be available for a period of not fewer than 10 years

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: the license applicant passes a jurisprudence examination
